**Chinese name:** 深圳市汇顶科技股份有限公司 (Shēnzhèn Shì Huìdǐng Kējì Gǔfèn Yǒuxiàn Gōngsī)

::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Founded 2002 in Shenzhen; known as China's 'fingerprint chip king,' a major global supplier of fingerprint and touch sensor ICs to smartphone makers. Analyst consensus as of May 2026 (two covering institutions) projected modest, steady full-year 2026 growth — EPS of ¥1.91 (+4.95% YoY) and net profit of ¥886 million (+5.84% YoY) — a contrast to the much sharper swings (up and down) seen elsewhere in this tracker's 2026 updates.
:::

## What does this firm design?

Fingerprint sensors (ultrasonic, optical in-display, and capacitive) and touch/display-integrated sensor ICs.
